previousIssues.issue: w7a/w7b (high in B, medium in A): Type A door lining mirrored fore-aft
previousIssues.status: still fixed. m18 (L2, screen right = forward): arming window upper left (aft), stop bar by the grip, and the arc sweeping to a down-pointing arrowhead on the right (forward). previousIssues.issue: w8a/w8b medium: welcome galley glass pane opaque, contents gone, diagonal sheen bar
previousIssues.status: partly fixed. The tilted sheen bar is gone, and the pane tone now matches the photo (m03 (660,250) #4d4742 vs omaat_room_32 (800,600) #4e4c4a). It still does not read as glass. The three shelf 'shadow' quads at 1.20/1.45/1.70 are drawn ON the pane as solid black rails, so m03 (585-740, 150-440) and m16 (640-860, 130-510) look like a four-panel charcoal door. Shelves, boxes and the lit interior are invisible. In omaat_room_32 (x 735-905, y 180-700) and lalf_134 (x 905-1010, y 300-770) you see the contents: a box at about 1/3 height, a white tray, a shelf edge and a vertical reflection near the hinge.

issues.detail: Welcome galley cabinet still reads as a panelled door, not glass
issues.problem: The sheen bar is gone, but the three shelf-shadow quads drawn on the pane at y 1.20/1.45/1.70 (#3a3835) now read as solid door rails. With the uniform #6a645f pane on top, the cabinet looks like a four-panel charcoal door. The shelves, boxes and lit interior behind it are invisible.
issues.evidence: w9/m03_welcome.png pane (660,250) #4d4742 with black rails at y~205, 300, 395 (x 600-740); w9/m16_welcomeObl.png (640-860, 130-510). omaat_room_32.jpg (735-905, 180-700): contents visible, pane #4e4c4a at (800,600). lalf_134.jpg (905-1010, 300-770): white tray and box visible.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley (10_mono.js l.331-333), delete the loop that adds the three gQuad(0.34, 0.012) '#3a3835' rails, and drop the full-size pane quad at o+0.088. Instead, bring the interior forward so it reads through: the shelves l.326 and boxes l.327-328 are already there. Raise their e to ~0.06 (lit cabinet) and keep their colours. Then add only two narrow vertical sheen strips in front: gQuad(0.035, 0.68) at gc+0.12 and gc+0.155, colour '#7b766f', r 0.08, m 0.2, at o+0.088. Optionally add a 0.34 x 0.70 quad at 25 % mix if a glass/alpha material exists in MAT (MAT.glass).

issues.detail: Welcome galley recess cheeks and head are ash; photos show light grey/white
issues.problem: In both photos the welcome unit sits in a recess with light grey/white inner side walls and a white recess ceiling, framed by a satin-aluminium picture-frame edge. Ash appears only on the outer monument face and the lower doors. The render clads the inner cheeks (l.289) and the head above the opening (l.292) in streaky ash, which adds a warm wood band over and beside the black unit.
issues.evidence: lalf_134.jpg inner right cheek (x 1250-1380, y 200-830) light grey; recess ceiling (x 700-1350, y 150-200) white. omaat_room_32.jpg (1100,400) #e4e4e6 right wall, white ceiling above. w9/m03_welcome.png (800,300) #524635 ash cheek; w9/m16_welcomeObl.png head band (130-930, 0-110) ash.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildWelcomeGalley: l.289 ash cheeks gBox(0.03, 2.0-dk, set) -> MONMAT.galleyWhite or a new MONMAT.recessGrey {c:'#d9d6cf', r:0.5, l:LAYER.plastic}. In l.292, give the head's underside and inner face the same light material (keep barAsh only on a thin outer-face skin: add gBox(w, m.h-1.995, 0.01) at o=0.005 in barAsh and change the deep box to recessGrey).

issues.detail: Standard galley inserts and brewers render dark; the real ANA galley is light alu with stainless brewers
issues.problem: Steel and alu are metallic (steel m 0.85, alu m 0.45, aluDark m 0.5), so with the weak environment term in the set-back bank they render dark charcoal. The brewer heads are deliberately bevBlack. In the real ANA galley the inserts are light warm-grey alu, the brewers have stainless housings with polished pots and black handles, and the lever latches are large copper-orange. The same metallic darkening turns the welcome galley's 'silver brewer' into a dark grey box.
issues.evidence: sansY_44.jpg: insert faces (400,300) #9b9386 and (560,780) #999089, stainless brewers at (650-1000, 0-270), copper latches (510-640, 670-790). w9/m09_d4fwd.png: ovens (230,300) #3f3f3f, standard unit (380,330) #454544, brewer (90,270) #070708, latch (95,198) #350c09. w9/m03_welcome.png brewer (170,400) #33373e.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js MONMAT: alu -> {c:'#c4c2bc', r:0.45, m:0.15}, aluDark -> {c:'#b3b0a8', r:0.45, m:0.15}, so they read as satin light grey without relying on the env map. Add steelLit {c:'#c9ccd0', r:0.25, m:0.35, l:LAYER.brushed} and use it for the brewer housing and jug in buildGalley (l.442-449: head and bay back steelLit instead of bevBlack; keep a small bevBlack key panel 0.06 x 0.04). Jug (l.448): gCyl(0.055,0.06,0.14) steelLit plus a gBox(0.015,0.08,0.03) bevBlack handle at x+0.065 and a gCyl(0.04,0.04,0.015) bevBlack lid. Use the same steelLit for the welcome brewer (l.318-319). copper -> '#b5532a' and enlarge the latches to gRBox(0.03, 0.05, 0.03).

issues.problem: The upper-body faces render #161513-#191816, so the frames round the monitor, cubbies and cabinet disappear. The cream tag is a blank white bar, and the black caution text block on the cabinet top rail is missing.
issues.evidence: w9/m03_welcome.png (520,200) #191816 vs omaat_room_32 faces #222220-#2b2d26 with lit stile edges. Tag (605-705, 108-133) #dddbd5 blank vs omaat_room_32 (760-905, 70-125) with a pictogram. Caution panel omaat_room_32 (775-900, 140-185).
issues.fix: The bay backs at l.313 use '#1d1c19': lift to '#2a2925'. Add e:0.02 to MONMAT.welcomeChar, or add 4 mm '#57524b' edge strips on the stiles (l.315, l.329-330) so the frames read. l.336: add gQuad(0.05,0.04) '#5a5650' at gc-0.09 on the tag and a gQuad(0.12,0.012) '#8d887e' text strip. Add gQuad(0.2,0.08) '#151515' plus two gQuad(0.16,0.006) '#b9b5ac' lines at (gc+0.02, 1.80, o+0.112).

issues.detail: Bar blind still a black void; bottles opaque

issues.fix: MONMAT.blind: add e:0.04, and move the blind box from oU+0.066 to oU+0.085 so it clears the AO pocket. Slat lines (l.211): blackGloss -> {c:'#4a4846'}. MONMAT.bottleClear -> {c:'#c8d4d6', r:0.05, m:0.1, e:0.05}, and give the default bottle() label (MONMAT.label) a taller band (0.08 m) so the white label reads as in the render.

issues.detail: Door lining handle pocket near-black; jump seat too light
issues.problem: The horizontal handle pocket is painted '#4a4641' and renders near-black. The real pocket is mid grey. The folded jump seat renders almost as light as the lining. In lalf_133 it is about half the lining's value, with a dark slate seat pad.
issues.evidence: w9/m18_doorL2.png pocket (393,372) #201f1e vs lining (450,250) #b8b6b1; lalf_133.jpg pocket (675,590) #85746b vs lining (650,600) #ebd7bc. Jump seat m18 (345,350) #a7a9ab vs lalf_133 (565,800) #746d65 and seat pad (570,600) #2a303a.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js l.807: pocket quad '#4a4641' -> '#9a9288'. MONMAT.jump -> '#6c6a67'. In the jump-seat loop (l.861-862), add a gRBox(0.40, 0.42, 0.012, 0.02, 1) seat-pad face at y 0.78, z +0.04, colour '#2c3038' (LAYER.fabric).

issues.detail: Carry-overs: 2R deck stub, m04 seam, ebony grain
issues.problem: These are unchanged from w7/w8. The black deck stub lies on the ash base beside the 2R jump seat. A vertical seam shows in the lower middle ash flap. The door-1 ebony shows long harsh horizontal streaks in grey-mauve.
issues.fix: buildGalley l.420: drop segments narrower than 0.35 m (filter b - a > 0.35) so no stub deck is drawn next to the jump-seat panel. buildAshWall: the vertical line is probably the gap between the jump-seat panel / centre body and the flap; check the n/pw arithmetic for w ~1.62 (n = 3) and lift the flap box (l.361) to depth 0.014 at o 0.007 so it covers the body seam. MONMAT.darkWood -> c '#3a2b24' (warmer), and reduce the LAYER.fWood streak contrast/length in 03_tex.js (shared file, one-line LAYER_PARAMS edit).
